summary.description: Exact-product official documentation identifies an integrated 3200 mAh battery, 80 W maximum output, 30 A maximum output current, 12 V maximum output voltage, and 0.15 ? minimum resistance. The device provides power regulation, temperature control, and Smart mode, which adjusts power automatically for the installed coil; it does not provide user-selectable voltage or current regulation. Independent vaping editorial sources establish exact-product vaping use, but do not replace the manufacturer profile with an independently measured ceiling.
